ruleDefinitions.name: Change the Fax Dll
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect possible persistence using Fax DLL load when service restart Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Fax\\\\Device\\ Providers\\\\.*") AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\ImageName.*")) AND  NOT (Details = "\%systemroot\%\\system32\\fxst30\.dll")
